summary: Remove client metadata, trust, a service reservation, group membership, or the client
detail:
unset client <CLIENT-ID> trust
  Block management trust / credential use.
  Identity/trust: management blocked
  Public ports: reserved (kept)
  Confirmation follows revoke semantics

unset client <CLIENT-ID> service <SERVICE-ID>
  Release one published service reservation only.
  Client identity: kept
  Selected service port: released
  Confirmation: type RELEASE

unset client <CLIENT-ID>
  Remove the client record/management identity and release ALL service ports.
  WHAT WILL BE REMOVED
    client registry record
    management identity
    ALL service reservations
    ALL public ports
  WHAT WILL NOT HAPPEN
    no remote host deletion
    no local software uninstall
  Confirmation: type RELEASE

Do not use unset client <CLIENT> <SERVICE> — require the explicit 'service' keyword.
Metadata forms: unset client <CLIENT> label|note|tag …
Group membership: unset client <CLIENT> group <GROUP>
